_comment_mail_triage: Autonomous email triage (junk-flagging/draft-reply/auto-filing) layered on the same iCloud Mail account. mail_category_folders overrides where each category files to -- e.g. {"order_inquiry": "Print Orders"} -- and only needs entries for categories whose folder isn't already right; the folders it names must already exist in the account, since this never creates one. Omit mail_category_folders entirely to use the built-in defaults (see mail_triage.DEFAULT_CATEGORY_FOLDERS).
_comment_llm_backend: 'ollama' runs on the local model; 'claude_cli' runs on the Claude Code CLI (and so the user's claude.ai subscription). Switching is this one line.
_comment_claude_tools_api_key: Authenticates the MCP bridge subprocess to /api/tools/call. Equivalent to full owner access - anything holding it can invoke every Jarvis tool.
_comment_business: Omit this whole block and the business/second-in-command side stays off — no tools, no agents, no digest. Nothing here belongs in code: the predecessor project hardcoded its city and the module died when the business moved.

business.name: YOUR BUSINESS NAME
business.notes: Any standing context the research agents should know.

_comment_gpu_bridge: simrig as a shared inference resource for agent work that doesn't need Claude (image analysis, bulk text). Queued, model-routed, and released to the owner the moment he says he's gaming or racing. gpu_task_models overrides the task->model routing; put model choices here, not in code, because they age in weeks.
_comment_comfy: ComfyUI on the GPU box for image (Z-Image Turbo) and video (Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B) generation. A separate server from Ollama on the same machine. Omit comfy_host and image/video jobs fail with a clear message instead of running.
_comment_business_agents: Master switch for unattended agent runs. Off means nothing fires on a timer; agents still run on demand from chat.
_comment_personal_research: How often the background agent checks for personal errands ('find me a dentist') to research. Not gated behind business_agents_enabled — this runs regardless.
